lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in four primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The central two rows display the most regular spatial distribution with consistent inter-centroid distances.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear features of elevated intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a grid-like pattern where blobs often serve as vertex points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition (bright upper edge to shadowed lower edge) extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a non-uniform distribution of high-luminance blobs, with a cluster of approximately 10 spots primarily located in the lower two-thirds of the fin's surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant concave indentation is present on the dorsal ridge immediately posterior to the first dorsal fin, indicating tissue loss or healed trauma. Irregular markings are also visible on the distal edge of the right pectoral fin.
